tooltip.ancient_dragon.sky_wing.descript: Wings reforged from skyveil membrane, their veins aglow with pale blue light.
tooltip.ancient_dragon.mountainforged_ne: A dragonscale-overlaid helm, weighty yet responsive.

tooltip.ancient_dragon.mountainforged_sk: The final relic-armour, uniting a dragonscale cuirass with the Skyvault Wings.
tooltip.ancient_dragon.mountainforged_ne: Legguards as steadfast as the mountain against a frontal assault.

tooltip.ancient_dragon.mountainforged_ar: Trait: Greater toughness and knockback resistance than Netherite
tooltip.ancient_dragon.dragonbone_nether: A Netherite blade tempered anew with ancient bone, glowing deep violet.
Ancient bone reinforces both head and haft against the hardest targets.
Bone grain runs through the head, rending deep rock and metal.
A digging tool combining Netherite resilience with ancient draconic strength.
A tool reforged with ancient bone, resistant to the passage of ages.
A slender dragonbone runs through the spear, made for savage thrusts.
tooltip.ancient_dragon.storm_horn.descri: Forged from a Storm Dragonhorn, it calls a gale that drives the bearer onward.
tooltip.ancient_dragon.storm_horn.abilit: Use: Dash toward your aim · 30 second cooldown

book.ancient_dragon.chronicle.gate_opene: The gate is not a prison. After the catastrophe, survivors wrote their final record in the deep and left this way for those still willing to continue.
What sleeps in the mountain is not a bound calamity. It is the last watcher of the old world; remember that before you pass through this gate.
book.ancient_dragon.chronicle.dragon_awa: The mountains are the remnant land it carried, the storm the calamity it held beyond the border, and the sun the life it has not yet spent.
It could not save civilization, only seal its final watch into sleep. The mountain wakes now not from hatred, but because someone has come near.
book.ancient_dragon.chronicle.slain_by_d: The storm did not know your name, nor hate your footsteps. It is only carrying out a watch whose masters have long since vanished.
If you return to the Sacred Mountain, do not mistake thunder for malice. The old world is silent; only its duty remains unwilling to let go.
book.ancient_dragon.chronicle.dragon_fal: The last watcher has reached its sunset. You did not correct an error; you ended a watch older than every surviving record.
The corpse, dragon heart, and Sunheart Altar are not ordinary spoils. The old world has entrusted its mountain, storm, and sun to those who came after.
